body:
## What it does

Runs on request rather than firing at you constantly, and works in local time so the morning brief lands in your morning rather than someone else's. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @byeleni shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
